desc:
🪐 Welcome to Steal a Planet!

How to Play:
☄️ Steal meteors from space guardians
🐣 Hatch meteors into planets on your plot
💰 Earn money from your planets, even while you're offline
⬆️ Upgrade your plot, treadmill, and jetpack
👟 Train on your treadmill to gain Speed and reach harder biomes
⚔️ Steal meteors from other players
🌙 Watch out for nightfall, when every meteor changes!
✨ Discover rarer planets and bigger sizes!

Code "milkyway250" Next code at 1k likes!

Join my group to be the first one to know about events and updates and claim your group rewards https://www.roblox.com/share/g/519419888


🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
